upstream.name: Collateral set — NOT ESTABLISHED
upstream.unresolved_note: ⚠️ DELIBERATELY UNRESOLVED RATHER THAN GUESSED. msUSD is crypto-overcollateralised across ethereum, optimism, base and plasma, with collateral priced through each chain's own masterOracle — and the report NEVER ENUMERATES the collateral tokens. Establishing them needs a DepositToken enumeration per registered pool on all four chains, which is an on-chain read this pass did not do. An empty upstream array would read as 'no dependencies'; this entry says 'dependencies exist and are unrecorded'.

upstream.name: Per-chain masterOracle
upstream.note: Collateral is valued through a different oracle on each of the four chains, so oracle risk is not shared across them.

upstream.name: fxUSD — 95.6% of the Curve msUSD/fxUSD pool
upstream.note: ⚠️ A VENUE EDGE, AND AN EXTREME ONE. fxUSD is 95.6% of the only pool msUSD trades against, so msUSD's exit is effectively denominated in fxUSD alone — with msUSD itself last marked near $0.70. Not collateral: it bears on the liquidity axis. This is the edge fxusd_dependencies.json asserted; it is now derivable and correctly typed.

dependencies.upstream_resolution_rule: ⚠️ EVERY upstream entry MUST carry exactly one resolution: `slug` (one asset we score), `slugs` (a set entry naming several), `terminal: true` + `kind` (never scoreable — oracle, venue, contract, authority, incentive, real-world, protocol), or `unresolved` (scoreable, no report yet = COVERAGE GAP). ⚠️ TERMINAL AND UNRESOLVED ARE DIFFERENT CLAIMS and must never be merged: terminal means nothing is missing, unresolved means a report is owed. `address` is REQUIRED wherever the ticker collides in this corpus (DUSD x4, msUSD x3, reUSD x2, USD3 x2, BOLD x2) — a ticker-keyed graph would merge Resupply's reUSD (3.5) with Re Protocol's (5.0).
dependencies.coverage_note: ⚠️ Written 2026-10-01 to record the fxusd -> msusd-metronome edge as EXPLICITLY UNRESOLVED rather than leave the asset with no file at all — an absent file and an empty one are different claims, and only the second can be audited. ⚠️ ADDRESS IS LOAD-BEARING: THREE live tokens answer to msUSD (Mainstreet, Metronome, and the ticker's third holder). This is Metronome's, 0xab5eB14c09D416F0aC63661E57EDB7AEcDb9BEfA. ⚠️ We score this 1.5 and hold none; `last_verified` 2026-08-16.

downstream_basis.asserted_only_note: None — every asserted edge is reproducible from an upstream array.
downstream_basis.do_not_hand_edit: ⚠️ downstream_tracked is GENERATED. Hand-maintaining both directions is how fxsave came to list fxUSD as BOTH its upstream and its downstream — one edge recorded twice, in opposite directions. Add the edge to the UPSTREAM array of the dependent asset and re-run build.

dependencies.edge_kind_rule: ⚠️ EDGE KIND MATTERS AND fxUSD's HAND-WRITTEN DOWNSTREAM LIST CONFLATED TWO. `backing` means my SOLVENCY depends on this asset; `venue` means my EXIT PRICE does. Both are real and the response differs — a backing dependency moving calls for a re-read of the collateral analysis, a venue dependency moving calls for a re-read of the liquidity axis. A work queue that cannot tell them apart sends the same instruction for both.
